verdict.rationale: WorkOS publishes a broad set of official SDKs. These include the Node package (@workos-inc/node), Python with full async parity, Rust, iOS, Laravel, and several AuthKit framework libraries (React, Next.js, Astro, TanStack Start, client-side JS). The docs also describe production-grade behavior: automatic retries with exponential backoff, typed models and errors, pagination helpers, and PKCE public-client modes. A published OpenAPI spec backs these SDKs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, since the community evidence does not discuss the SDKs.
